# package catalog

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/catalog"
```

Package catalog indexes parsed namespaces for lookup, search and comparison.

A [Catalog](#type-catalog) holds any number of namespaces, including several releases of the same standard, and never prefers one release over another: a lookup whose name more than one loaded namespace defines fails with a [\*model.AmbiguityError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#AmbiguityError) instead of guessing.

A [Profile](#type-profile) is an explicit, consistent selection: at most one release per standard, with every declared dependency satisfied. Lookups on a profile are unambiguous as long as its namespaces do not define the same name twice; [Profile.Diagnostics](#func-profile-diagnostics) reports such conflicts and type references the profile cannot resolve.

	c, err := catalog.New(pkg72, pkg73, pkg74)
	p, err := c.Profile(model.NamespaceID{Standard: "IEC 61850-7-4", Version: "2007", Revision: "B", Release: 5})
	ln, err := p.LogicalNode("MMXU")
	dos, err := p.DataObjects("MMXU") // including inherited data objects

[Diff](#func-diff) compares two sources (namespaces, packages, profiles) and reports added, removed and changed definitions.

Catalogs and profiles are immutable and safe for concurrent use. The definitions they return are shared and must not be modified.

## Types

### type Catalog

```go
type Catalog struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Catalog is an immutable index of namespaces. It may hold several releases of the same namespace; no release is preferred over another.

The lookups of a Catalog (LogicalNode, CDC, ...) search every loaded namespace and fail with a [\*model.AmbiguityError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#AmbiguityError) when a name is defined more than once, for instance by two releases of IEC 61850-7-4. Build a [Profile](#type-profile) to select a consistent set of releases.

A Catalog is safe for concurrent use. The namespaces it holds, and every definition returned by its lookups, are shared and must not be modified.

#### func New

```go
func New(sources ...Source) (*Catalog, error)
```

New builds a catalog from the namespaces of the given sources. Two namespaces with the same ID are rejected with [model.ErrNamespaceConflict](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrNamespaceConflict). Namespaces are not copied: do not modify them after New returns.

#### func (Catalog) DataObjects

```go
func (v *Catalog) DataObjects(lnClass string) ([]InheritedDataObject, error)
```

DataObjects returns every data object of a logical node class, including inherited ones and those added by extension classes of other namespaces: those of the root class first, then each subclass in turn, each followed by its extensions, in document order. A data object redeclared later replaces the earlier one at its position.


DataObjectsIn returns every data object of the class as namespace ns defines it, including inherited ones and those of extension classes.

#### func (Catalog) DefaultProfile

```go
func (c *Catalog) DefaultProfile() (*Profile, error)
```

DefaultProfile returns a profile of every loaded namespace when the catalog holds exactly one release of each standard. Otherwise it fails with a [\*model.AmbiguityError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#AmbiguityError): no release is preferred implicitly, so select releases with [Catalog.Profile](#func-catalog-profile).

#### func (Catalog) Inheritance

```go
func (v *Catalog) Inheritance(name string) ([]*model.LogicalNodeClass, error)
```

Inheritance returns the class chain of a logical node class, starting with the class itself and ending with its root class. Base classes are resolved in the scope of the namespace of each class (see Scope). It fails with [model.ErrCycle](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrCycle) on cyclic inheritance and with [model.ErrUnknownLogicalNode](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrUnknownLogicalNode) when a class is not defined.


InheritanceIn returns the class chain of the class as namespace ns defines it, base classes resolved in the scope of each class.

#### func (Catalog) LogicalNode

```go
func (v *Catalog) LogicalNode(name string) (*model.LogicalNodeClass, error)
```

LogicalNode returns the concrete or abstract logical node class with the given name. It fails with [model.ErrUnknownLogicalNode](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrUnknownLogicalNode) when no namespace defines it, and with a [\*model.AmbiguityError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#AmbiguityError) when more than one does.

Extension classes (isExtension, e.g. MMXU in IEC 61850-7-420) add data objects to the class of the same name and are not candidates: the base definition is returned, and \[view.Extensions] lists the extensions. An extension whose base class is not loaded is returned itself.


LogicalNodeIn returns the logical node class with the given name as namespace ns defines it. The ID may be partial ("IEC 61850-7-420").

#### func (Catalog) Overlaps

```go
func (v *Catalog) Overlaps(left, right model.NamespaceID) ([]Overlap, error)
```

Overlaps compares every name that both namespaces define. The IDs may be partial ("IEC 61850-7-420"). Zero IDs compare every pair of namespaces of the set. Logical node classes are compared with their resolved structure: inheritance chain and every data object with its CDC and presence, inherited ones included. Results are ordered by kind, name and namespaces.

PresenceCondition returns the definition of a presence condition.

#### func (Catalog) Profile

```go
func (c *Catalog) Profile(ids ...model.NamespaceID) (*Profile, error)
```

Profile builds a profile from the selected namespaces and their dependencies.

Each ID may be partial: "IEC 61850-7-4" with no version selects the only loaded release of that standard, and fails with a [\*model.AmbiguityError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#AmbiguityError) when several are loaded. Dependencies that are not selected are added when exactly one loaded release satisfies them; otherwise the call fails with a [\*model.DependencyError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#DependencyError) (missing, ambiguous, or conflicting with a selected release).

Problems that do not prevent lookups, such as a name defined by two namespaces of the profile or a type reference that resolves to no definition, are reported by [Profile.Diagnostics](#func-profile-diagnostics).

#### func (Catalog) Releases

```go
func (c *Catalog) Releases(standard string) []model.NamespaceID
```

Releases returns the IDs of the loaded releases of a standard, e.g. every loaded release of "IEC 61850-7-4", in order.

#### func (Catalog) ResolveNamespace

```go
func (v *Catalog) ResolveNamespace(id model.NamespaceID) (model.NamespaceID, error)
```

ResolveNamespace returns the namespace of the set that a possibly partial ID designates: the exact ID, or the only namespace matching the fields that are set ("IEC 61850-7-420" without a version). It returns [model.ErrUnknownNamespace](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrUnknownNamespace) when none matches and an [model.AmbiguityError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#AmbiguityError) when several releases do.

#### func (Catalog) Scope

```go
func (v *Catalog) Scope(id model.NamespaceID) []model.NamespaceID
```

Scope returns the namespaces a definition of namespace id sees: id itself, then its dependencies in the set, breadth first.

#### func (Catalog) Search

```go
func (v *Catalog) Search(q Query) []Result
```

Search returns the elements matching q in a stable order: by kind, path and namespace. Data objects are listed where they are declared; inherited data objects are not repeated for each subclass.

#### func (Catalog) Standards

```go
func (c *Catalog) Standards() []string
```

Standards returns the distinct standards of the loaded namespaces, in order.

### type Change

```go
type Change struct {
	Kind ChangeKind `json:"kind"`
	// Element is the kind of element, e.g. "LNClass", "DataObject",
	// "DataAttribute", "Literal" or "Dependency".
	Element string `json:"element"`
	// Path locates the element, e.g. "MMXU.TotPF" or "MV.mag".
	Path string `json:"path"`
	// Field is the changed property for [Changed], e.g. "type".
	Field string `json:"field,omitempty"`
	// Old and New are the property values for [Changed].
	Old string `json:"old,omitempty"`
	New string `json:"new,omitempty"`
	// Description is a one-line summary.
	Description string `json:"description"`
}
```

Change is one structural difference between two model versions.

#### func Diff

```go
func Diff(oldSrc, newSrc Source) []Change
```

Diff compares the definitions of two sources, for instance two releases of a namespace or two profiles, and returns the structural differences in a stable order (by path, element and field).

Definitions are matched by name, regardless of the namespace that defines them. Each side should define each name once, as a profile does; when a side defines a name more than once, the definition of the first namespace in ID order is compared.

### type ChangeKind

```go
type ChangeKind string
```

ChangeKind classifies a difference.

```go
const (
	Added   ChangeKind = "added"
	Removed ChangeKind = "removed"
	Changed ChangeKind = "changed"
)
```

Change kinds.

### type Overlap

```go
type Overlap struct {
	// Kind is the kind of definition: logical node class, CDC,
	// constructed attribute or enumeration.
	Kind  Kind              `json:"kind"`
	Name  string            `json:"name"`
	Left  model.NamespaceID `json:"left"`
	Right model.NamespaceID `json:"right"`
	Class OverlapClass      `json:"class"`
	// OnlyLeft and OnlyRight list the members (data objects, data
	// attributes, literals) only one definition has.
	OnlyLeft  []string `json:"onlyLeft,omitempty"`
	OnlyRight []string `json:"onlyRight,omitempty"`
	// Differences describe members both have that differ, and other
	// differences such as the inheritance chain.
	Differences []string `json:"differences,omitempty"`
}
```

Overlap is a name that two namespaces of the set both define, with the comparison of the two definitions.

### type OverlapClass

```go
type OverlapClass string
```

OverlapClass classifies two definitions of the same name.

```go
const (
	// OverlapIdentical: the resolved structures are equal.
	OverlapIdentical OverlapClass = "identical"
	// OverlapCompatible: one definition extends the other; everything
	// the smaller one defines, the larger one defines the same way.
	OverlapCompatible OverlapClass = "compatible-extension"
	// OverlapConflicting: the definitions differ in what both define,
	// or each defines something the other does not.
	OverlapConflicting OverlapClass = "conflicting"
)
```

Overlap classes.

### type Profile

```go
type Profile struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Profile is a consistent selection of namespace releases: at most one release per standard, with every declared dependency satisfied by a release in the profile.

A Profile offers the same lookups as a [Catalog](#type-catalog), restricted to its namespaces, plus inheritance-aware data object lookups. It is safe for concurrent use.


Overlaps compares every name that both namespaces define. The IDs may be partial ("IEC 61850-7-420"). Zero IDs compare every pair of namespaces of the set. Logical node classes are compared with their resolved structure: inheritance chain and every data object with its CDC and presence, inherited ones included. Results are ordered by kind, name and namespaces.

#### func (Profile) PresenceCondition

```go
func (v *Profile) PresenceCondition(name string) (*model.PresenceConditionDef, error)
```

PresenceCondition returns the definition of a presence condition.

#### func (Profile) ResolveNamespace

```go
func (v *Profile) ResolveNamespace(id model.NamespaceID) (model.NamespaceID, error)
```

ResolveNamespace returns the namespace of the set that a possibly partial ID designates: the exact ID, or the only namespace matching the fields that are set ("IEC 61850-7-420" without a version). It returns [model.ErrUnknownNamespace](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrUnknownNamespace) when none matches and an [model.AmbiguityError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#AmbiguityError) when several releases do.

#### func (Profile) Scope

```go
func (v *Profile) Scope(id model.NamespaceID) []model.NamespaceID
```

Scope returns the namespaces a definition of namespace id sees: id itself, then its dependencies in the set, breadth first.

#### func (Profile) Search

```go
func (v *Profile) Search(q Query) []Result
```

Search returns the elements matching q in a stable order: by kind, path and namespace. Data objects are listed where they are declared; inherited data objects are not repeated for each subclass.

#### func (Profile) String

```go
func (p *Profile) String() string
```

String returns the IDs of the profile, separated by ", ".

### type Query

```go
type Query struct {
	// Kinds restricts the result to these kinds.
	Kinds []Kind
	// Name matches element names case-insensitively as a substring, or
	// exactly (case-sensitive) when Exact is set.
	Name  string
	Exact bool
	// CDC restricts data objects to those of this CDC and logical node
	// classes to those declaring such a data object.
	CDC string
	// Type restricts data attributes and sub data attributes to those
	// of this type.
	Type string
	// FC restricts data attributes to those with this functional
	// constraint.
	FC model.FunctionalConstraint
	// Standard restricts the result to definitions of namespaces of
	// this standard, e.g. "IEC 61850-7-4".
	Standard string
	// Group restricts logical node classes, and their data objects, to
	// this group.
	Group model.LNGroup
	// IncludeAbstract includes abstract logical node classes and their
	// data objects.
	IncludeAbstract bool
}
```

Query selects catalog elements. Empty fields do not filter. A filter that does not apply to a kind excludes that kind: with FC set, only data attributes are returned.

### type Result

```go
type Result struct {
	Kind Kind `json:"kind"`
	// Name is the element name.
	Name string `json:"name"`
	// Path is the element path: the name for top-level definitions,
	// "MMXU.Hz" for a data object, "MV.mag" for a data attribute and
	// "Vector.mag" for a member of a constructed attribute.
	Path string `json:"path"`
	// Namespace is the namespace that defines the element.
	Namespace model.NamespaceID `json:"namespace"`
	// Type is the CDC of a data object or the type of an attribute.
	Type string `json:"type,omitempty"`
	// FC is the functional constraint of a data attribute.
	FC model.FunctionalConstraint `json:"fc,omitempty"`
	// Presence is the presence condition of a data object or attribute.
	Presence model.PresenceCondition `json:"presence,omitzero"`
	// Abstract marks abstract logical node classes and their data
	// objects.
	Abstract bool `json:"abstract,omitempty"`
	// Variant is the CDC variant of CDC and data attribute results.
	Variant string `json:"variant,omitempty"`
	// Extension marks extension classes and the data objects they add.
	Extension bool `json:"extension,omitempty"`
}
```

Result is one search hit.

### type Source

```go
type Source interface {
	Namespaces() []*model.Namespace
}
```

Source provides namespaces. \*nsd.Package, \*model.Namespace, \*Catalog and \*Profile implement it.
